scripts.bootstrap:self-hosted:stable: npm install && npm run build:release:stable && uv sync --group dev
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @clipulse/collector-core && npm run build --workspace @clipulse/adapter-claude && npm run build --workspace @clipulse/adapter-codex && npm run build --workspace @clipulse/adapter-gemini && npm run build --workspace @clipulse/adapter-opencode
scripts.build:release:stable: npm run build --workspace @clipulse/collector-core && npm run build --workspace @clipulse/adapter-claude && npm run build --workspace @clipulse/adapter-codex
scripts.check:beta: npm run build && npm run test && npm run lint:api && npm run smoke:stable && npm run smoke:experimental
scripts.check:beta:ci: npm run smoke:repo-guardrails && npm run build && npm run test && npm run lint:api && npm run smoke:stable && npm run smoke:experimental
scripts.check:py-build: rm -f dist/clipulse_api-* && uv run --with build python -m build --sdist --wheel
scripts.check:release:prep: npm run check:release-metadata:stable && npm run smoke:repo-guardrails:stable && npm run build:release:stable && npm run test:release:stable && npm run lint:api && npm run smoke:stable && npm run check:py-build && npm run check:py-install-smoke && npm run check:package:stable
scripts.check:release:prep:full: npm run check:release:prep && npm run smoke:experimental
scripts.lint:api: PYTHONPATH=apps/api uv run ruff check apps/api
scripts.smoke:experimental: npm run smoke:adapters:experimental && npm run smoke:self-hosted:experimental
scripts.smoke:stable: npm run smoke:adapters:stable && npm run smoke:self-hosted
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:py
scripts.test:js:release:stable: vitest run packages/collector-core/test packages/adapter-claude/test packages/adapter-codex/test apps/web test/check-py-install-smoke.test.ts test/stable-packaging.test.ts test/docs/repo-release-stable-parity.test.ts test/docs/repo-release-stable-hygiene.test.ts test/smoke-deployment.test.ts test/smoke-shared.test.ts
scripts.test:release:stable: npm run test:js:release:stable && npm run test:py
